text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: It's a public holiday, so club activities are canceled. However, Misato was working alone, taking care of some behind-the-scenes chores.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日は祝日で部活は休み。
しかしミサトは一人、裏方の作業をこなしていた。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Phew, that's the laundry done. It's such a nice day today, it should dry in no time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ、
お洗濯終わり
っと。
今日もいい天気だから
すぐ乾きそうね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my, good morning. What brings you here? Club activities are canceled today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
おはよう。
どうしたの？　
今日の部活はお休みよ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I thought I'd get everyone's laundry done while I had the chance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなのために、
お洗濯物をね。
今のうちに
やっておこうかと思って。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're wondering why since it's a day off? ...I know. It's a perfectly good day off, but... um, don't laugh, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
お休みなのに、
って？
……
そうよね。
せっかくのお休みなんだけど、
その……
笑わないでね？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I've lived in the Elven Forest my whole life, so, um... I don't really know how to spend my time at the beach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
ずっとエルフの森で暮らしてきたから、
その……
海で
どうやって過ごせばいいのか、
よく分からなくって。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: As a teacher, I should be able to teach people how to enjoy their time in such places too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
先生として、
海の楽しみ方も
教えられるようにならなくちゃ
いけないんだけどね……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: You will teach me... how to enjoy the beach?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたが
教えてくれるの？
海の楽しみ方を……？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Sure... That would make me very happy. Then I'll gladly take you up on your offer♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
とってもうれしいわ。
じゃあ、
お言葉に甘えちゃおうかしら♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Okay then, I'll be counting on you all day♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
今日一日
よろしくね♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: It's still only morning, but it's already packed, and everyone looks like they're having so much fun♪ Everything feels so different from the Elven Forest. I can't remember the last time I felt this excited.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだ午前中なのに
人もい
っぱいで、
みんな楽しそう♪
何もかもエルフの森と違って新鮮だわ。
こんなにワクワクするの
いつ以来かしら。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Hey, now that we've arrived at the beach... what should we do?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ、
海に来たら
何をすればいいのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Ehehehe, you're right. Before anything else, we should get something to eat. I'm looking forward to beach food♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふふ、
そうね。
何をするにも
まずはごはんよね。
海のごはん、
楽しみだわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Yakisoba, frankfurters, grilled squid, shaved ice... It all looks so delicious♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
焼きそばに
フランクフルト、
イカ焼きかき氷。
どれも美味しそうねぇ♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Eating while standing outside feels a little improper, but I suppose that's part of what makes it so enjoyable. That said...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お外で立ち食いなんて、
ちょっとお行儀が悪い感じだけど、
そのドキドキも含めて美味しく感じるのね。
でも──

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Sheesh! This beach food is awesome! I already finished mine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒュー！　
海の飯、
バリうまじゃーん！
俺もう食い終わっちゃったぜー！

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: Then let's grab something else! The beach is the best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ
次はあれ食うか！　
海サイコー！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Looking more closely, this beach has been littered with trash. What a waste of a beautiful ocean...
text_block_list.orig_text:
よく見ると、
ビーチのあちこちがゴミだらけね。
せっかくの海なのに……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Sorry. I'm going to pick up some of that trash. A clean beach is a clear ocean!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんね。
私、
ちょっとゴミ拾ってくるわね。
海はきれいな方がいいもの。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Sensei is so happy to see you grow into such a reliable boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう。
本当に頼りになる子に成長してくれて、
先生うれしいわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's split up and get to work!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
手分けしてやりましょう。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Phew, the beach looks completely different now that the trash is gone. It really gives a good feeling to see it so clean.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ、
ゴミがなくなったおかげで、
砂浜が見違えるようになったわ。
きれいになると
やっぱり
気持ちいいわね。

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, what are you two doing? Let us join in, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねーねーお姉さんたち、
何やってるの？
僕たちも仲間に入れてよ？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: My oh my! But are you sure? It's just picking up trash, you know? It might not be very interesting for you children...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら。
でもいいの？
ゴミ拾いよ？　
あなたたちには
あまり面白くはないかも……

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: It's fine! I also prefer the beach to be clean! I'd love to pick up trash with you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいよー！　
私も海はきれいな方がいいもん！
一緒にゴミ拾いやりたーい！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my, you're all such good kids~ Let's get to some trash picking then! Together with me and him, let's make this beach a cleaner place♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
みんないい子ね～
それじゃあ
一緒にゴミ拾いしましょう。
お兄さんお姉さんと一緒に、
きれいを
いー
っぱい
増やしちゃおうね♪

text_block_list.name: Boy and Girl
text_block_list.text: Yes!
text_block_list.orig_text: はーい！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Huh? The hell are those people doing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あん？　
何やってんだあいつら。

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: They came all the way to the beach to pick up trash? That's hilarious! If you want to dirty your hands so badly, have some more!
text_block_list.orig_text:
海に来てわざわざゴミ拾い？　
チョーうけるぜ！
そんなに拾いたけりゃあ、
ほらよ！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Yay! I got one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったー！　
ポイントゲット！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's not fair! I found that first!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー
ずるい！　
私が先に見つけたのにぃ。

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Hmph, I'll find an even bigger one with you, Onii-san! Let's go together!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふんだ、
お兄さんと一緒に
もっとおっきいの見つけるからいいもん！
行こ、
お兄さん！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Ah! W-Wait!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ま、
待てよ！

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: Hah. What's with them...? Annoying...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ。
なんだよあいつら……
うぜー

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: This is kind of anticlimactic. Shall we call it here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか白けちまったな。
そろそろ帰るか？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my, leaving already? It seems you haven't really enjoyed the beach yet...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら、
もうお帰りですか？
まだ
あまり海を楽しんでいないみたいですけど……

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: Huh? A-And you are...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
あ、
あんたは……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Thanks to those children, the beach is sparkling clean now, isn't it? Isn't it more fun to play somewhere nice and clean?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの子たちのおかげで、
海がピカピカになったでしょう？
きれいなところで遊べば、
もっと楽しいですよね。

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: Huh? I-I don't give a damn about the beach right now! Hey, let's hurry home...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ？　
も、
もう海とかどうでもいいし！
おい、
さっさと帰ろうぜ……

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Hey, you... why did you come all the way to the beach just to pick up trash? Look at the place! Shouldn't you be out there enjoying yourself?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なぁ、
あんた、
どうしてわざわざ海に来てまで、
ゴミ拾いなんてしてんだ？
せっかくの海なんだ、
楽しんだ方がいいだろ？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: There are certainly a variety of activities to have fun with at the beach. But picking up trash is fun too, you know? Cleaning up the beach so that everyone can play in it with a smile...
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに、
海には楽しいことがいっぱいあるわ。
だけど、
ゴミ拾いも楽しいのよ？
海をきれいにして、
その海で、
みんなが
笑顔で遊んでくれる……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Seeing such a sight... it just warms up Sensei's heart.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうのを見ているとね、
先生、
すごく胸が温かくなるの。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Which is why... I hope you will all enjoy this beach♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからね、
あなたたちももっと、
この海を楽しんでいってくれると
うれしいわ♪

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: ...Happy to see someone smile, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……誰かが笑顔になるのがうれしい、
か。

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Hey... Can we... pick up some trash, too?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なあ……
俺たちも……
ゴミ拾い、
やってもいいか？

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: HUH?! Hey, what are you saying--...
text_block_list.orig_text:
は！？
おい、
オマエ何言って──

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Look at them. This person and those brats look like they're having more fun than us, don't they? Don't you envy them?
text_block_list.orig_text:
見てみろよ。
この人も、
あの子どもも、
俺たちより楽しそうだろ。
なんか、
うらやましくないか？

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: And besides, we're making them pick up the trash we threw away, right? We're so lame.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それによ、
俺たちが捨てたゴミを拾わせてんだぞ？
クソダサだろ、
俺たち。

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: U-Ugh...! ...You're right. I can't stand being lame...! Alright, let's do this! I won't lose to some brats!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっ……！
……
そう、
だな。
ダセーことは許せねえもんな……！
よっし、
やるか！　
ガキどもになんか負けてらんねーぜ！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: My oh my! Ehehehe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
うふふ。

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! How's that you brats?! This is the power of an adult!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっはー！　
どうだガキども！　
これが大人の実力だぜ！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Not bad for someone who joined in halfway through.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふん、
後から来たくせになかなかやるじゃん。

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Uncle! I'm thirsty!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねーねーおじさん、
私のど乾いたー！

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: I'm no "Uncle", I'm more of a "Brother"! Fine, I'll treat you, so come with me. Oh, and make sure you throw your trash in the trash can, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おじさんじゃねーし！　
お兄さんだし！
仕方ねえ、
おごってやるからついてこい。
あ、
ゴミはちゃんとゴミ箱に捨てんだぞ？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. They've all become such good friends.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
あんなに仲良くなっちゃって。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Yes. Very much so. The beach has become cleaner, and above all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ。
とっても。
海もきれいになったし、
なにより……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: I was able to connect people. That's a very good thing♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
人と人とを繋げることができたわ。
とってもいいことね♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's give it one more push! Afterwards, let's have lots of fun playing in this beautiful beach!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
私たちももうひと頑張りしましょ。
その後は、
きれいな海で
いっ
ぱい
遊びましょうね！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Misato smiled brightly as she continued to clean the beach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミサトは輝くような笑顔で、
海をきれいにしてゆくのであった。
